description_en: Deletes an application by the specified ID or type
description_zh: 删除指定ID或类型的应用
kebab_example: aliyun arms delete-trace-app --app-id 540600 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --type TRACE --pid 9w0sc5gxxz@edcsd447c2f0000 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteTraceApp

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application to delete. You can call the SearchTraceAppByName operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 需要删除的应用的ID，可调用SearchTraceAppByName接口获取
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the application to delete. You can call the SearchTraceAppByName operation to obtain the type. For more information, see SearchTraceAppByName. Valid values:

`TRACE`: Application Monitoring
`RETCODE`: Browser Monitoring
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除的应用的类型，可调用SearchTraceAppByName接口获取，更多信息，请参见SearchTraceAppByName。包括以下类型：

`TRACE`：应用监控
`RETCODE`：前端监控
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The application ID.

In the Application Real-Time Monitoring Service (ARMS) console, choose Application Monitoring > Applications and click the name of the target application. The URL in the browser address bar contains the PID of the application in the format of pid=xxx. Because the browser encodes the PID, you must modify the PID. For example, if the PID in the URL is xxx%4074xxx, replace %40 with @. The PID is xxx@74xxx
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。

在ARMS控制台的应用监控>应用列表页面单击目标应用名称。此时浏览器地址栏中的URL即包含应用的pid，格式为pid=xxx。由于浏览器进行了编码，因此需要对pid稍作修改。例如，如果URL中包含的pid为xxx%4074xxx，则需要将%40替换为@，即：xxx@74xxx
parameters.name: pid
